newsitem.title: ISRAEL: First Intl Israel gets $120 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: First Intl Israel gets $120 mln loan.

text.p: The First International Bank of Israel said on Sunday it had signed an agreement with a consortium of international banks for a $120 million five-year loan.
The bank said the interest rate on the loan was Libor plus 0.275 percent for the first three year and Libor plus 0.3 percent for the last two years.
The bank said the loan would finance middle-term forex activity.
Germany's Deutsche Bank and Japan's Sumitomo Bank organised the consortium. The agreement was signed in London last Wednesday.
In 1996 Sumitomo headed an international consortium that extended a $100 million loan to the Israel bank for five years.
